description: This is a Flutter Dart source file defining the 'HomeScreen' widget for the Ludo mobile app. It constructs the main menu UI with various options like Play Online, Pass & Play, vs AI, Store, Profile, and Settings, as well as placeholders for planned integrations and feature flags.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing the main home screen of the app, displaying menu options for different game modes and features.

classes.name: _PlaceholdersCard
classes.description: A StatelessWidget displaying placeholders for planned integrations and current feature flags.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including app bar and menu options.

methods.name: _showPlaceholderSnack
methods.description: Displays a SnackBar with a placeholder message when certain menu options are tapped.
